domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert to improper form
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers (including nonstandard mixed numbers) and whole numbers as equivalent improper fractions or equivalent fractional forms suitable for computation.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a nonstandard mixed number (e.g., 1 4/3) as a + b/c and then as a single fraction
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: A step only finds/chooses a common denominator and scales fractions (tag S02)
A step performs the subtraction once forms are compatible (tag S03)
A step reduces to lowest terms or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number/integer (tag S04)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly computes an LCM/common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to create equivalent fractions with a shared denominator
A step chooses a convenient common denominator and converts both fractions to that denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtraction (tag S03)
A step only converts mixed/whole numbers to fractional form without addressing unlike denominators (tag S01)
A step reduces/simplifies after subtraction (tag S04)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible forms (e.g., same denominator or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
A step produces/handles a zero result from subtracting equal quantities
exclusion_criteria: A step only converts numbers to improper/equivalent fractional form (tag S01)
A step only finds/applies a common denominator without subtracting (tag S02)
A step only reduces or re-expresses the final result (tag S04)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as an equivalent mixed number or integer (including identifying whole-number results) when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or to an integer/whole number (including 0)
exclusion_criteria: A step only performs the subtraction without any reduction or re-expression (tag S03)
A step changes denominators to enable subtraction (tag S02)
A step converts mixed/whole numbers into fractional form prior to subtraction (tag S01)
